body:
Adds `research/mode-elicitation` (stdlib-only Python, MIT): the bounded window loss `1[|y−r|>α]` elicits the α-mode of drift. Includes exact window-mass regret, best window width (`α=σ` normal, `γ/√3` Cauchy), a closed-form critical width `α*` for bimodal drift, detection sample sizes, and a contamination-robustness experiment. 7 tests pass; white paper, README, root README entry and portfolio page section included.
